protocol.configuration: cube on; old geometric weight; no visibility; direct diffuse only; RC, path guiding, spatial reuse, denoiser and TAA off; voxel grid 16
protocol.quality: 256 warmup frames; single raw and 32 consecutive frames, eight batches, mean, variance, valid counts and incomplete batches; SSBO12 tree and SSBO14 audit in same frame
protocol.mask: Per scene intersect all four complete-pixel masks (all channels valid_count == 32 and incomplete_batches == 0), then receiver and fixed ROI masks. Nonfinite samples are counted per case and channel; raw values are not clipped or repaired. 32-frame variance is not reference MSE.
protocol.profiling: Per scene four cases forward then reverse, each 128 warmup and 128 measured frames. Initial composite41 and brick prepare7 p50; tree is sum of average compute times for all mapped prepare6 through prepare19 LightSamplingBuild passes, including empty wide dispatches; prepare2 is sentinel.
protocol.comparison: 40 images; exposure 6; native Scene, Method, Accumulation dimensions; lossless AVIF from PNG.

syntax_validation.scope: Static GLSL validation with stubbed external inputs, not target Iris or runtime evidence

page_validation.lossless_check: All 40 AVIF assets decoded at 1920x1080 and compared pixel-for-pixel against their PNG sources.
page_validation.browser_check: Headless Chrome: three dimensions, selection, next, space toggle, 2x zoom retained; no page errors.

last_verified_runtime.live_read_only_check: Vibris status and resource catalog returned matching active source UUID and settings hash; scene and full settings are from the last profile provenance.
